note: Cycle 1 HIGH findings (timing oracle, spoofable IP) and 6 medium findings verified fixed independently against diff/CI/real-Postgres concurrency test.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Neuer Nutzer kann sich registrieren und wird automatisch Owner eines neuen Tenants
Fehlerhafte Anmeldeversuche geben keine Enumerationshinweise preis

review_findings.summary: enable_confirmations=true path discards the typed tenant name/slug, forcing re-entry at /account fallback -- follow-up ticket needed before Epic 3 closes.
Fire-and-forget audit write can be dropped on serverless (Workers) without Next.js after()/waitUntil -- follow-up needed.
IP-only bucket blocks shared-office IPs after 5 failures by any one user -- follow-up: raise IP threshold or step-up challenge.
record_failed_login_audit_event lets anonymous callers inject rows attributed to the victim as actor.
createTenantAction has no server-side zero-membership guard -- unbounded tenant creation per user.

residual_risks: 200ms timing floor has no headroom above measured GoTrue latency -- needs prod p99 measurement.
Rate limiter fails open on DB error.
minimum_password_length=6 in config.toml vs 12-char app rule -- direct GoTrue signups weaker than app path.
required_actions: None blocking. Carry the 3 medium findings into follow-up tickets before Epic 3 closes.
